question: What should you write at the very top of a letter? ✉️
explanation: Awesome! We always start a letter with our address so the reader knows where it came from! 🏠
hint: It tells the receiver where you live.

question: What comes right after the sender's address? 📅
explanation: Great job! We write the date to show exactly when the letter was written! 📅
hint: It has the day, month, and year.

question: How do we greet a close friend in a letter? 👋
explanation: Super! We use 'Dear' for friends and family because we love them! 💖
hint: Use a friendly and warm word.

question: How do we greet a teacher or principal? 🏫
explanation: Awesome! We use 'Respected' to show polite manners to our teachers and principals! 👔

question: What is the main message of the letter called? 📝
explanation: Great job! The body of the letter holds all the important news and messages you want to share! 📝
hint: It is the biggest part of the letter.

question: How do we end a letter to our mother? 🥰
explanation: Super! We use 'Yours lovingly' for family members to show our sweet affection! 🥰
hint: It shows a lot of love.

question: How do we end a letter to the school principal? 🙇
explanation: Awesome! 'Yours obediently' is the perfect and polite way to end a school letter! 🙇
hint: It means you follow their rules.

question: A letter to a friend or cousin is called an? 🎈
explanation: Great job! Letters to friends and family are informal, meaning they are casual and fun! 🎈

question: A letter to a principal or manager is called a? 👔
explanation: Super! Formal letters are polite and professional, used for schools and offices! 👔

question: What goes at the very end, under the closing? ✍️
explanation: Awesome! You must write your name or sign at the end so they know who sent it! ✍️
hint: It is what people call you.

question: What is 'May 10, 2024' an example of? 📅
explanation: Great job! That is the date, which tells us exactly when the letter was written! 📅
hint: It has a month and a year.

question: What special line do formal letters need? 📌
explanation: Super! A subject line is a short sentence that tells what the formal letter is about! 📌
hint: It tells the main topic quickly.

question: What does the subject line tell the reader? 🔎
explanation: Awesome! The subject line gives the reader a quick peek at the main reason for the letter! 🔎

question: What do we write on the outside envelope? ✉️
explanation: Great job! The envelope needs the receiver's address so the postman knows where to go! 🏡

question: What sticky square goes on the envelope? 📯
explanation: Super! A postage stamp pays for the letter to travel to its destination! 📯
hint: You buy it at the post office.

question: What part of the letter is 'Dear Grandma'? 👋
explanation: Awesome! 'Dear Grandma' is a lovely greeting to start your informal letter! 👋

question: Where does 'How are you?' go in a letter? 🗣️
explanation: Great job! Questions and news go right into the body of your letter! 🗣️
hint: The main part of the message.

question: A letter to invite a friend to your birthday is a? 🎂
explanation: Super! Birthday invites to friends are fun and casual, so they are informal letters! 🎂

question: What part of the letter is 'Lots of love'? 👋
explanation: Awesome! 'Lots of love' is a very sweet closing before you write your name! 👋

question: Why do we write a 'Thank You' letter? 🙏
explanation: Great job! A 'Thank You' letter is a beautiful way to show gratitude for a gift or help! 🙏

question: What is a group of sentences about one idea called? 📝
explanation: Super! A paragraph is a neat group of sentences that all share the same main idea! 📝
hint: It is bigger than a sentence.

question: What is the first sentence of a paragraph called? 🎯
explanation: Awesome! The topic sentence introduces what the whole paragraph is going to be about! 🎯

question: What do the middle sentences of a paragraph give? 🧩
explanation: Great job! The middle sentences add supporting details to make the topic clear and fun! 🧩

question: What is the last sentence of a paragraph called? 🏁
explanation: Super! The concluding sentence wraps up your thoughts and finishes the paragraph nicely! 🏁

question: What is the small space before the first word of a paragraph called? ➡️
explanation: Awesome! We leave a little space called an indent to show where a new paragraph begins! ➡️

question: A good paragraph should focus on how many main ideas? 💡
explanation: Great job! A strong paragraph sticks to one main idea so it is easy to read! 💡

question: What does a topic sentence do? 🚪
explanation: Super! The topic sentence opens the door and introduces the main idea to the reader! 🚪

question: What do supporting details do? ℹ️
explanation: Awesome! Supporting details give fun facts and more information to explain your idea! ℹ️

question: What does a concluding sentence do? 🎁
explanation: Great job! It wraps up the paragraph like a beautiful bow on a present! 🎁

question: How should sentences in a good paragraph feel? 🌊
explanation: Super! Good sentences flow smoothly into each other like a gentle river! 🌊

question: What must every sentence begin with? 🔠
explanation: Awesome! Every single sentence must start big and proud with a capital letter! 🔠

question: What must a telling sentence end with? 🔴
explanation: Great job! We use a full stop at the end to show the sentence is completely finished! 🔴

question: What is 'My Pet Dog'? 🐕
explanation: Super! 'My Pet Dog' is a wonderful topic to write a whole paragraph about! 🐕
hint: It is an idea to write about.

question: In a paragraph, what must all sentences do? 🎯
explanation: Awesome! All sentences must hold hands and stay on the same topic together! 🎯

question: An application for sick leave is what type of letter? 👔
explanation: Great job! A leave application to a school is official, so it is a formal letter! 👔

question: Why do we write a leave application? 🏖️
explanation: Super! We write it when we need a holiday or are sick and cannot go to school! 🏖️

question: A letter to your Uncle is what kind of letter? 🎈
explanation: Awesome! Letters to our sweet uncles and aunts are informal and very friendly! 🎈

question: Where do we use 'Dear Sir/Madam'? 👔
explanation: Great job! 'Dear Sir/Madam' is a highly respectful greeting for formal letters! 👔

question: What should you do before writing a paragraph? 🧠
explanation: Super! Always think and plan your ideas first before putting them on paper! 🧠

question: What do joining words help us do? 🔗
explanation: Awesome! Joining words like 'and' or 'but' hold sentences together like strong chains! 🔗

question: Which of these are joining words? ➕
explanation: Great job! Words like 'and', 'but', and 'because' join shorter sentences into better ones! ➕

question: Writing a paragraph about how you look is called a? 🙋
explanation: Super! When you describe how something looks or feels, it is a descriptive paragraph! 🙋

question: What is a great way to learn to write better? 📚
explanation: Awesome! Reading lots of good books gives us wonderful new words and ideas for writing! 📚

question: What makes writing letters and paragraphs fun? ✨
explanation: Great job! Writing is magical because we get to share our amazing ideas with the world! ✨

question: Who do we send a 'Get well soon' letter to? 🤒
explanation: Super! We send it to a sick friend to wish them a fast and happy recovery! 🤒

question: A letter of apology means you are doing what? 😔
explanation: Awesome! An apology letter is a very brave way of saying you are sorry for a mistake! 😔

question: What exactly is the sender's address? 🏠
explanation: Great job! The sender is YOU! So the sender's address is where you live! 🏠

question: What exactly is the receiver's address? 📫
explanation: Super! The receiver is the person getting the letter, so it is where the letter goes! 📫

question: An email is just like a? 💻
explanation: Awesome! An email has a subject, body, and closing just like a digital letter sent on a computer! 💻
hint: It is sent on the internet.

question: Why do people write letters? 💌
explanation: Great job! We write letters to connect with others and share love, news, and important messages! 💌
